Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over

instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

boardcells=sorted(target)
cell_index={p:i for i,p in enumerate(boardcells)}

placements=[]

    for rr in range(6-h+1):

            abs_cells=[(rr+r,cc+c) for r,c,v in shape]
            if not all(p in cell_index for p in abs_cells): continue
            mask=0
            for p in abs_cells: mask |= 1<<cell_index[p]
            pid=len(placements)
            placements.append((ti,rr,cc,mask,tuple((rr+r,cc+c,v) for r,c,v in shape)))
            for p in abs_cells: bycell[cell_index[p]].append(pid)
print('placements',len(placements), 'per type',Counter(p[0] for p in placements))

# Exact-cover search. Pieces keep their shown orientation; colors are retained for output.
areas=[len(s) for s in type_shapes]
initial_rem=tuple(qty)
failed=set(); visits=0; answer=None
# Larger tiles first when branching.
ptype_order=sorted(range(len(qty)), key=lambda i:(-areas[i], qty[i]))
def dfs(covered, rem, path):
    global visits, answer
    visits+=1
    if covered==targetmask:
        if not any(rem):
            answer=path[:]
            return True
        return False
    key=(covered,rem)
    if key in failed: return False
    best_cell=-1; best_cands=None; best_n=10**9
    uncovered=targetmask & ~covered
    x=uncovered
    while x:
        b=x & -x; ci=b.bit_length()-1; x-=b
        cands=[]
        for pid in bycell[ci]:
            ti,rr,cc,mask,paint=placements[pid]
            if rem[ti] and not (mask & covered): cands.append(pid)
        n=len(cands)
        if n<best_n:
            best_n=n; best_cell=ci; best_cands=cands
            if n==0: break
    if not best_cands:
        failed.add(key); return False
    best_cands.sort(key=lambda pid:(-areas[placements[pid][0]], placements[pid][0]))
    for pid in best_cands:
        ti,rr,cc,mask,paint=placements[pid]
        nr=list(rem); nr[ti]-=1
        if dfs(covered|mask, tuple(nr), path+[pid]): return True
    failed.add(key)
    return False
solved=dfs(0,initial_rem,[])
print('solved',solved,'visits',visits,'failed states',len(failed),'nplacements',len(answer or []))
